description: Supercapacitor linear charger; 0.40 A typ (R40 750 Ω), V_reg 4.18 V (R43/R44)
5 F / 2.7 V supercapacitors in series (2.5 F), balanced by R45/R46 15 kΩ
220 µF 6.3 V polymer tantalum, 15 mΩ ESR
3.3 V 500 mA LDO for the modem V_IO and buffers
Single buffers with I_off (unpowered-safe), 5.5 V-tolerant inputs
10 mΩ 1 W shunt for burst-current measurement
Iridium passive helical antenna, 2.8 dBic, SMA plug
No LEDs in Rev A; CHG_STAT and CHG_PG on test pads TP4 and TP5
